edition.title: Patrologiae cursus completus, Series Latina, Tomus XCII

work.author: Jacques-Paul Migne, publisher and series editor
work.description: Volume 92 of Migne's Patrologia Latina, the third Migne volume of Bede's works, printing his genuine exegetical works and containing the commentaries on Luke and on Acts. A container volume: its constituent works keep their own identities and are not reassigned to Migne. Bede's exposition of Luke 7:11-17 falls at cols. 417-420.
work.title: Patrologiae cursus completus, Series Latina, volume 92
